title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
description: Alice follows a white rabbit into a strange underground world. Her encounters with talking animals, puzzling rules and an unpredictable queen turn an ordinary afternoon into an extraordinary adventure.

title: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
author: L. Frank Baum
description: Carried away from Kansas by a cyclone, Dorothy sets out through Oz to find a way home. A scarecrow, a tin woodman and a lion join her journey to meet the mysterious wizard.

title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
description: Dr Watson recounts twelve investigations led by Sherlock Holmes. From unusual visitors to carefully concealed crimes, the detective uses close observation and reasoning to uncover what others overlook.

title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
description: A death on Dartmoor raises fears of a terrifying family curse. Holmes and Watson investigate the threats surrounding the Baskerville heir and search for a human explanation behind a seemingly supernatural danger.

title: The Moonstone
author: Wilkie Collins
description: A valuable diamond disappears after arriving at an English country house. Accounts from several people reveal conflicting clues, hidden motives and the consequences of the jewel's troubled history.

title: The War of the Worlds
author: H. G. Wells
description: An invasion from Mars overturns everyday life in England. An unnamed narrator struggles to survive as unfamiliar machines and weapons expose how vulnerable human society can be.

title: The Time Machine
author: H. G. Wells
description: An inventor travels far into the future and discovers a world unlike his own. His encounter with the Eloi and Morlocks becomes an unsettling exploration of humanity, change and social divisions.

title: Journey to the Centre of the Earth
author: Jules Verne
description: A decoded message leads a professor, his nephew and their guide into an Icelandic volcano. Their expedition reveals vast underground spaces and unexpected dangers beneath the Earth's surface.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: Elizabeth Bennet and Mr Darcy misjudge each other amid family expectations and pressure to marry. As their understanding changes, both must reconsider the assumptions that shape their choices.

title: Jane Eyre
author: Charlotte Brontë
description: After a difficult childhood, Jane becomes a governess at Thornfield Hall. Her growing attachment to Mr Rochester tests her independence when the house's secrets challenge the future she imagines.

title: Sense and Sensibility
author: Jane Austen
description: The Dashwood sisters face reduced circumstances and uncertain romantic prospects. Elinor's restraint and Marianne's openness lead them through disappointment as they learn to balance feeling with judgment.

title: Treasure Island
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
description: A map draws young Jim Hawkins into a voyage in search of buried treasure. Mutiny and shifting loyalties force him to navigate the dangers posed by Long John Silver and his fellow pirates.

title: The Call of the Wild
author: Jack London
description: Taken from his comfortable home, Buck is sold as a sled dog in the North. Harsh conditions and new loyalties draw him toward the wilderness and a life beyond domestication.

title: Around the World in Eighty Days
author: Jules Verne
description: Phileas Fogg and his companion Passepartout attempt to circle the globe within eighty days. Their wager becomes a race through delays, misunderstandings and unexpected encounters across continents.
